Note: To honour the witnessing of the tragic death of Dolly Parton, here is the cd compilation, "Legendary" which she didn't release on streaming services. Sending my condolences to the Parton and Owens family for their loss and from us fans to you Dolly (queen of country music), we love you so much and thank you for being such an iconic role model through your music, through your talents, through your acting, through your stories and especially through you. Rest peacefully and may your legacy continue on for many more generations to come.

Love,
